title: Efficiently Scaling Transformer Inference
description: Systematic analysis of how to partition large transformer inference across TPU/GPU pods. Introduces the arithmetic intensity framework for choosing between model parallelism strategies. Shows when tensor parallelism vs. pipeline parallelism vs. batch splitting is optimal as a function of model size, batch size, and hardware topology.
authors: Pope, Douglas, Chowdhery, Devlin, Bradbury, Levskaya, Heek, Xiao, Agrawal, Dean (Google)
